fato_historico: 1320: The so-called Black Parliament at Scone tries William II de Soules and other nobles who had plotted against Robert I of Scotland and intended to place William on the Scottish throne.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to ground your ambitions today, Taurus. It is a good time to solidify your loyalties and nurture the foundations of your sanctuary, bringing a sense of lasting peace to your daily routine.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in remaining loyal to your own authentic path.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of shifting perspectives toward greater stability.
conselho: Consider simplifying your schedule today to focus on what truly brings you comfort.
